name: General Relativity
epithet: the smooth-spacetime theory of the big — gravity as curvature

name: Quantum Mechanics
epithet: the grainy, quantized theory of the small — packets and probability

name: The Graviton
epithet: gravity's hypothetical force-particle — massless, spin-2, never detected

name: The Planck Scale
epithet: the smallest length (~1.6e-35 m) and the energy (~1e19 GeV) where quantum gravity lives

name: Spacetime Foam
epithet: Wheeler's churning quantum vacuum — smoothness dissolving at the Planck scale

name: The Singularity
epithet: where General Relativity predicts infinity — the heart of a black hole; the map's edge

name: The First Instant
epithet: the Big Bang at quantum size — the other place both theories must meet

name: String Theory
epithet: vibrating strings in ~11 dimensions; the graviton emerges, but ~1e500 solutions and no evidence

name: Loop Quantum Gravity
epithet: spacetime quantized directly — space woven from discrete loops; elegant, unconfirmed

name: The Renormalization Wall
epithet: why the naive quantization of gravity fails — uncancellable infinities the other forces survived
